headline: Two new encampment roles discussed; a motion on the job description was made, but no vote was recorded.
summary: The city proposed two new roles to handle homeless encampments, working with an existing code compliance officer. Members discussed whether police must be part of outreach and how to pay for the positions. A motion to accept the job description was made, but the transcript shows no vote on it.
discussion: Encampment response: Officials said current responses only move people from site to site, and that regular visits and two new roles would help address public health and quality-of-life concerns.
Law enforcement role: Members debated whether outreach workers need a police officer present, citing safety risks and the need to enforce rules.
Funding sources: Members discussed moving the $25,000 set aside for a committee, and whether opioid settlement money could be used for the positions.
Job description approval: Members debated whether to accept the job description now and leave funding questions for finance or council.
Fire department encounters: Fire staff reported 151 encounters with homeless people in 2022, 195 in 2023, 246 in 2024, 296 in 2025, and 309 so far this year.
